# Suggested GitHub topics

Maintainers can set these under the repository's **About → settings → Topics**:

```text
mcp ai-agents payments stablecoins usdc base x402
```

The `x402` integration is a [planned Phase 2](../ROADMAP.md#phase-2-x402-paid-http-resources) capability until that phase is implemented and validated. Keep repository descriptions and launch posts clear about the current testnet/simulation boundaries. Suggestions here do not automatically change GitHub metadata.
